name: Turkey Meatballs in Cream Sauce Skillet

fit.note: 433 cal in [400,650], 16 g carbs <= 35, no starch base, scales by weigh-and-divide; cal sits near the 400 floor so label-DB recompute has limited downside headroom but clears as published.

dupe_evidence: No turkey duplicate: the 11 catalog turkey-meatball entries are all distinct flavor families (Greek lemon-orzo, youvarlakia, Indian kofta curry, Izmir potato bake, BBQ-over-rice, Thai coconut curry, Italian wedding soup, marinara pasta, sub bake, Japanese tsukune, Vietnamese xiu mai) - none is a creamy roux/broth-and-cream gravy skillet, so this occupies an open slot.
cross_protein_collisions: beef swedish-meatball-potato-bowls (Swedish Meatball and Potato Bowls) - structurally the SAME dish family: meatballs in a creamy Worcestershire cream gravy; differs by protein (beef vs turkey) and by carrying a potato base this bare skillet lacks. Decider should confirm this reads as a distinct turkey take, not a re-skin.
